fields.value: AMS 4911 annealed Ti-6Al-4V, minimum yield 827 MPa, minimum ultimate 896 MPa, density 4.43 g/cm3. The pin shear is 0.6 times that yield, derived here, not a handbook shear.
fields.issue: The sheet exists today. At 562.2 kN the sleeve is 0.075 kg per end and 157.7 kg, 0.70 times the 225.5 kg allowance. Frozen least SF is 1.232 by the film. Re-optimised least SF is 1.431 at k 0.2 and 1.995 at k 0.4.
